Name: Give Krobus a Pumpkin
Author: Greghog
Description:
Just a simple portrait mod that gives Krobus a pumpkin. Makes him look cuter, I guess.

Pick one of the two files, download, extract, and put it in the Stardew Valley folder. It replaces the original portrait file for Krobus, so back it up if you want to.
